_comment: Import this file through the Pelican or Pterodactyl admin panel's Nests/Eggs import action.
name: Soaring Photos
author: admin@example.com
description: Private, invite-only family photo and video sharing app built with Next.js, Prisma, and SQLite.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

export HOME=/mnt/server

if [ -z "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
  echo "GIT_REPO must be set to the repository URL."
  exit 1
fi

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates

git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPO}" .
npm ci
npx prisma generate
npx prisma migrate deploy
npm run build

mkdir -p "${UPLOAD_DIR}"

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: HTTPS or SSH URL of the Soaring Photos Git repository.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: A unique random secret with at least 32 characters. Do not change it after users have signed in.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Keep the default to store the SQLite database in the server's persistent directory.

variables.name: Upload Directory
variables.description: Persistent directory for locally stored uploads. Use S3 settings instead when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: Storage Driver
variables.description: Use local for files in UPLOAD_DIR, or s3 for an S3-compatible object store.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Used only when manually running npm run db:seed for the first time.

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Used only when manually running npm run db:seed for the first time.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Used only when manually running npm run db:seed for the first time. Choose a strong password.

variables.name: S3 Endpoint
variables.description: Optional endpoint for MinIO or another S3-compatible storage service.

variables.name: S3 Region
variables.description: Region for S3-compatible storage when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: S3 Bucket
variables.description: Bucket name when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: S3 Access Key
variables.description: Access key when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.

variables.name: S3 Secret Key
variables.description: Secret key when STORAGE_DRIVER is s3.
